questions.explanation: Qatar hosted the 2022 World Cup, the first tournament held in the Middle East.

questions.question: Who is the all-time top scorer in FIFA World Cup history?
questions.explanation: Miroslav Klose scored 16 World Cup goals, surpassing Ronaldo's 15 in 2014.

questions.question: Which country has appeared in every FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Brazil is the only nation to have played in every World Cup tournament.

questions.question: How many times has Brazil won the World Cup?
questions.explanation: Brazil has 5 World Cup titles — 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, and 2002.

questions.question: Which African country was the first to reach the World Cup quarter-finals?

questions.question: Which player has scored the most international goals?
questions.explanation: Cristiano Ronaldo broke Ali Daei's record of 109 international goals in 2021.

questions.question: Who is Nigeria's all-time top scorer?
questions.explanation: Rashidi Yekini scored 37 goals for Nigeria, still the national record.

questions.question: Who is the youngest player to score in a World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Pelé was 17 years old when he scored in the 1958 World Cup final.

questions.question: Which club has won the most UEFA Champions League titles?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid has won the European Cup / Champions League more than any other club.

questions.question: Which English club has won the most Premier League titles?
questions.explanation: Manchester United has 13 Premier League titles, more than any other club.

questions.question: Which club is known as "The Red Devils"?
questions.explanation: Manchester United's nickname is "The Red Devils".

questions.question: How many players are on the field per team in a standard football match?
questions.explanation: Each team fields 11 players, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: How long is a standard football match?
questions.explanation: A standard match is two 45-minute halves, totalling 90 minutes plus stoppage time.

questions.question: What is it called when a player scores three goals in one match?
questions.explanation: Three goals in one game is called a hat-trick.

questions.question: What colour card means a player is sent off?
questions.explanation: A red card means immediate dismissal. Two yellow cards in one match also result in a red.
